purpose: Define operational, logistical, and infrastructure-stability protocols for municipal systems under the Munisible Task Force, ensuring ethical, non-punitive, and rights-centered support.

infrastructure_stability.description: Protocols ensuring safe, continuous operation of municipal infrastructure.

protocols.name: Critical Systems Monitoring
protocols.action: Continuously monitor utilities, transportation, and public facilities for anomalies.

protocols.name: Preventive Maintenance Cycle
protocols.action: Schedule and document maintenance cycles to prevent system failures.

protocols.name: Infrastructure Risk Assessment
protocols.action: Evaluate structural, environmental, and operational risks using telemetry indicators.

emergency_logistics_support.description: Non-punitive logistical support protocols for emergencies and disruptions.

protocols.name: Civilian-Centered Resource Deployment
protocols.action: Deploy resources prioritizing vulnerable populations and non-punitive support.

protocols.name: Continuity Activation Protocol
protocols.action: Activate continuity plans when critical systems show failure indicators.

protocols.name: Cross-Division Emergency Coordination
protocols.action: Coordinate with Community Safety, Telemetry, and Accountability divisions during crises.

resource_allocation.description: Protocols ensuring transparent, equitable distribution of municipal resources.

protocols.name: Equitable Distribution Standard
protocols.action: Allocate resources based on need, vulnerability, and rights-centered criteria.

protocols.name: Anti-Corruption Allocation Check
protocols.action: Use telemetry to detect irregular or biased resource distribution patterns.

protocols.name: Public Transparency Sync
protocols.action: Publish non-sensitive allocation data to public dashboards.

protocols.name: Continuity Plan Maintenance
protocols.action: Maintain and update continuity plans for all critical municipal systems.

protocols.name: Redundancy Activation
protocols.action: Activate redundant systems when primary systems show degradation.

protocols.name: Operational Bottleneck Detection
protocols.action: Identify workflow bottlenecks using telemetry and correct them proactively.

workflow_stabilization.description: Protocols ensuring municipal workflows remain efficient, ethical, and civilian-centered.

protocols.name: Non-Punitive Workflow Correction
protocols.action: Correct workflow issues without punitive measures toward staff or civilians.

protocols.name: Documentation Sync Protocol
protocols.action: Ensure all workflow changes are documented and anchored to audit trails.

protocols.name: Cross-Division Workflow Review
protocols.action: Review workflows with Civic Integrity and Accountability divisions for compliance.

kernel_dependencies.identity_kernel: Required for actor verification, authority classification, and documentation anchoring.
kernel_dependencies.telemetry_kernel: Required for anomaly detection, risk scoring, and infrastructure monitoring.
kernel_dependencies.ethics_kernel: Required for rights-centered evaluation and non-punitive operational logic.
